subject.title: feat(agents): composable termination algebra + GSAR grounding scorer

question: Should OpenClaw core accept library-only termination/GSAR primitives before a production sessions_send integration exists, or should this work move/park until the owner-approved API boundary is clear?
rationale: The PR is now intentionally unused groundwork, and repository vision favors a lean core unless the missing core or plugin API is the actual product decision.

options.title: Defer Core Merge
options.body: Keep the linked issue as the tracker and wait for an owner-approved sessions_send or agent-core API shape before merging these primitives.

options.title: Accept Core Groundwork
options.body: After the OrCondition blocker is fixed, land the library-only modules as a deliberate core API seed despite having no production caller yet.

options.title: Relocate The Surface
options.body: Move the primitives to `packages/agent-core` or a plugin-facing API if maintainers want extension authors to own policy composition first.

recommendation.title: Defer Core Merge
recommendation.body: Keep the linked issue as the tracker and wait for an owner-approved sessions_send or agent-core API shape before merging these primitives.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest current history in sessions_send and multi-agent routing, and is already mentioned for the remaining product call.
